Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) via malicious Microsoft Office documents exploiting CVE-2023-36884 vulnerability
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Office 2013/2016/2019 suite and apps (32-bit and 64-bit architectures)
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Office documents sent via email or message communication
Indicators of Compromise: Exploitation of CVE-2023-36884 Windows Search remote code execution vulnerability
